title: Surreal Ouroboros Vision
description: A surreal painting features a large bald head with wide eyes and an open mouth emitting blue rays and bubbles from the top. Below, a giant black beetle and snake form an ouroboros circle with a net pattern, containing a man in a futuristic black and gold suit firing a glowing yellow energy blast from his hand. The background shows green hills, small cartoon figures including rabbits and skeletons, and a stained glass window with multiple faces in the upper right.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting with a giant bald head with wide eyes and blue energy rays shooting from its screaming mouth at the top, a massive black beetle and snake forming an ouroboros circle with chainmail pattern in the center, inside the circle a man in black and gold futuristic armored suit dynamically poses while firing a bright yellow starburst energy blast from his outstretched hand, green rolling hills background with small cartoon rabbits skeletons and figures, colorful stained glass window with multiple distorted faces in the upper corner, dripping paint effects, detailed linework
